public.profile_secrets.handling: Deleted with the owning auth user; the patient-specific secret is not retained.

public.consent_logs_legacy.handling: Legacy consent rows are removed with the owning auth user.

public.reattestation_requests.handling: Requests and their account-linked review metadata are deleted with the auth user.

public.record_revisions.handling: Patient revisions and commitments are deleted with the auth user.

public.consent_events.handling: Consent history is deleted with the auth user.

public.chw_payouts.legalBasis: Financial and payment reconciliation records must remain auditable against the Stellar ledger.
public.chw_payouts.minimization: The auth user reference is set to NULL on account deletion; retain only payment and ledger reconciliation fields.

public.chw_identities.legalBasis: Credential and verification status is retained for operational security and fraud prevention.
public.chw_identities.minimization: Retain only the auth UUID, status, and verification timestamps; remove credential material and contact details.

public.chw_address_bindings.handling: Current address bindings and verification proofs are removed with the CHW identity.

public.emergency_capabilities.handling: Active shares are revoked before auth deletion; capability rows are deleted by cascade.

public.card_access_events.handling: Access events are deleted with the user; the independent 90-day purge is an additional limit.

public.card_access_events_2026_09.handling: Partitioned access-event rows inherit account deletion through the parent table.

public.card_access_events_2026_10.handling: Partitioned access-event rows inherit account deletion through the parent table.

public.card_access_events_2026_11.handling: Partitioned access-event rows inherit account deletion through the parent table.

public.card_access_events_2026_12.handling: Partitioned access-event rows inherit account deletion through the parent table.

public.card_access_events_default.handling: Partitioned access-event rows inherit account deletion through the parent table.

public.patient_blocking_keys.handling: Keyed duplicate-detection hashes are deleted with the auth user.

public.account_merge_requests.handling: In-progress merge requests are deleted with either participating auth user.

public.account_merge_audit.legalBasis: A verified account merge requires an audit record for dispute resolution and fraud prevention.
public.account_merge_audit.minimization: Retain only opaque account UUIDs, moved-field categories, and merge time; no names, contact details, or clinical values.

public.account_notification_outbox.handling: Unsent notification metadata is deleted with the auth user.

public.idempotency_keys.handling: Request replay keys are deleted with the auth user.

public.break_glass_accesses.handling: Patient-specific emergency access records are deleted with the patient auth user.

public.emergency_contact_notification_ev.handling: Notification events are deleted with the auth user; a separate 90-day purge also applies.

public.dependants.handling: Dependent profiles are deleted with the guardian auth user.

public.guardianships.handling: Guardian relationships are deleted with the guardian auth user.

public.guardian_audit_log.legalBasis: Safeguarding and access-accountability records are retained to investigate unauthorized dependent-data access.
public.guardian_audit_log.minimization: Retain event type, subject reference, and timestamp only; actor linkage must be removed when the account is erased.

public.user_sessions.handling: Application session metadata is deleted with the auth user.

public.chw_fraud_flags.handling: CHW-linked fraud findings are removed when the CHW account is erased.

storage.objects.handling: Avatar objects under the account UUID prefix are explicitly removed through Supabase Storage before auth deletion.
